integrity: The endpoint law is derived analytically from the unit-Weibull CDF and the positive-geometric minimum construction. The target's published Figure 2 and abstract were inspected directly, and the primary Weibull-geometric precursor was inspected in full-text HTML.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes global decreasing and global upside-down-bathtub hazards but does not classify all possible interior extrema.
A curve may look decreasing or single-humped on a truncated plotting interval before its mandatory terminal increase.
The indexed publisher page did not expose the target article body; the model formula was independently reconstructed from the stated compounding mechanism and primary precursor formulas.
title: A universal right-endpoint obstruction removes two advertised UWG hazard regimes
